additionalData.comment: Do NOT add rapidjson-macros for RapidJSON: its restore silently produces an empty extern/includes/rapidjson-macros/shared -- confirmed via a CI debug step listing the actual restored tree, and its own clone log shows zero submodule/content activity unlike every other dependency here, suggesting the package is stale/broken upstream. RapidJSON is vendored directly as a git submodule instead (see extern-vendor/rapidjson/ and CMakeLists.txt), pinned to the exact commit beatsaber-hook 6.4.2 itself already uses for its own bundled copy.

IMPORTANT: run `qpm dependency add bs-cordl -v <version-for-1.40.8>` and let qpm resolve the exact codegen version that matches Beat Saber 1.40.8_7379 for your headset. Codegen versions are minted per game build and must not be hand-guessed -- see README 'Verifying codegen against your exact build'.
RedBrumbler's Quest-BSML port (github.com/RedBrumbler/Quest-BSML). Pin to whatever release lists Beat Saber 1.40.x support on the mods.bsquest.xyz page for your build.
Logging shim for the Scotland2 modloader.
